name: San Carlos
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in San Carlos, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in San Carlos, CA: Night of Holiday Lights, Santa by helicopter at Hiller and the Eucalyptus Avenue lights.
lede: San Carlos, the City of Good Living, kicks off December with Night of Holiday Lights on Laurel Street, sends Santa in by helicopter at the Hiller Aviation Museum and lights up Eucalyptus Avenue all month.
celebrates: San Carlos Parks and Recreation and the Parks and Recreation Foundation of San Carlos present Night of Holiday Lights on Laurel Street, with kids' activities, arts and crafts, snow, a holiday show and tap dancing Christmas trees, plus special appearances by Santa Claus and the Snow Queen. A few days later Santa lands by helicopter at the Hiller Aviation Museum. All month, residents of Eucalyptus Avenue run their own display of holiday lights, which the city says is not a city sponsored event and manages with one way traffic and extra parking.
lastyear: The 15th Annual Night of Holiday Lights took place on Friday, December 5, 2025, from 5 to 8:30 pm on Laurel Street between San Carlos Avenue and Cherry Street, according to the Community Foundation of San Carlos. It offered kids' activities, hands on arts and crafts, festive lights, a holiday show with snow and live music, hot chocolate and holiday goodies, with beer and wine sold for adults. This year's event is the 16th annual one and takes place on December 4.
facts: San Carlos was incorporated on July 8, 1925, and its nickname is the City of Good Living. The original 1888 depot of its Caltrain station is built of Almaden sandstone and was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1984. During World War II a 178 acre site in the city became the United States Army War Dog Reception and Training Center. The Hiller Aviation Museum, home of more than forty aircraft, is also in San Carlos.
trains: The San Carlos Caltrain station keeps its original 1888 depot, built of Almaden sandstone and listed on the National Register of Historic Places, so a train ride to Laurel Street or the Hiller Aviation Museum area is a good family trip. For a bigger train day, San Francisco has a cable car museum and a railway museum for streetcar fans.
train_links: The working powerhouse of the city's cable car system, with the winding wheels in view.
A small museum on the Embarcadero about the historic streetcars of the F line.
The nonprofit that keeps San Francisco's historic streetcars running.
traditions: The city's free downtown celebration on Laurel Street with a holiday show, snow, crafts and music.
Special guests at Night of Holiday Lights.
Santa lands at the Hiller Aviation Museum and hears wishes until noon.
A month long, resident run display with one way traffic from December 4 to 28.
kidfact: San Carlos is called the City of Good Living, and during World War II a dog training center for the army stood on land in the city.
faq: When is Night of Holiday Lights in San Carlos?
Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5 to 8:30 pm on Laurel Street between San Carlos Avenue and Cherry Street. The city says it is free.
Is there a Santa helicopter in San Carlos?
Yes. Santa lands by helicopter at the Hiller Aviation Museum on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 10:30 am.
Are the Eucalyptus Avenue lights a city event?
No. The city says the residents of Eucalyptus Avenue organize the display and it is not a city sponsored event.
Where do I park for the Eucalyptus Avenue lights?
The city lists overflow parking at the San Carlos Youth Center lot, 1001 Chestnut Street.
Can we take the train to San Carlos?
Yes. San Carlos station is on Caltrain and keeps its historic 1888 depot.
